id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_030.pack|cs_: "We've been waiting, brothers! You came right away!
"These people... are they the ones you spoke of?
"Yes! Brother {var:1}! They'll listen to our story!
"You said you pretended to be monsters to stop the village rite. Tell us why.
"...We know everyone's in trouble if the rite isn't done. But it can't be! Because...
"Because if they do the rite, Mum will be thrown into the volcano as a sacrifice to the god of fire...!
"A sacrifice!? Is that what the rite is!? That's horrifying!
"...One day Miko gathered us and said:
"We have angered the god of fire. Without an offering the volcano will erupt and the village will become a sea of flames.
"At first we offered radishes and potatoes! But suddenly the sun stopped coming out, and food stopped growing...
"I see... The aftershock of Mordegon's birth reached this far...
"To protect the village and keep the offerings to the god of fire from ending, Miko declared she'd sacrifice a human.
"Miko receives the oracle of the god of fire on who is fit to be sacrificed. And... I was chosen.
"I thought desperately how to stop Mum, chosen as sacrifice, from going to the volcano, and then...
"I see... So that's why you did that. You protected your mother in your own way.
"If my death helps the village... I'm prepared to be the sacrifice. But these children...
"Don't say that, Mum! I don't get the village stuff, but I never want you to die!
"The other night, Mum saw Miko climb alone into the volcano, which is forbidden except for the rite.
"When I told Miko, Mum was chosen as sacrifice. As if to silence the one who saw...
"There must be a secret in the volcano. I want to expose it and save Mum! But I can't go alone...
"...Hm, so that's it. Then let's go see this volcano.
"Really!? Thank you! With you, we're a hundred men strong! We can explore deep in the volcano!
"Behind this secret base is a path to the volcano. Let's go into the volcano from there!"
